title: Staff Mobility IJRA at Wageningen University & Research Strengthens UGM–WUR Agricultural Research Collaboration
excerpt: Wageningen, Netherlands — Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, lecturer at the Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), and researcher at the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), conducted a staff mobility program at Wageningen University & Research (WUR), Netherlands, on 1–12 September 2026. body:
**Wageningen, Netherlands —** Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, lecturer at the Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), and researcher at the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), conducted a staff mobility program at Wageningen University & Research (WUR), Netherlands, on 1–12 September 2026. This activity is part of the International Joint Research Academy (IJRA), which aims to strengthen UGM's international research networks and collaborations.

The main agenda of the visit included exploring cooperation between UGM and WUR, discussing collaborative research, planning joint publications, and developing joint research proposals. During these activities, Dr. Andri held discussions with several research partners at WUR: Dr. Joseph Peller in the field of spectral imaging for plant phenotyping, Prof. Dr. Gerrit Polder in the field of spectral imaging technology, and Assoc. Prof. Gert Kootstra in the field of agricultural robotics.

![IMAGE_0]

Progress discussion of Joint Supervision with Prof. Gerrit Polder and Dr. Joseph Peller

One of the key discussion focuses was the development of research that integrates robotics technology and plant phenotyping for tropical agriculture. This approach is expected to support more objective, rapid, and accurate observation of plant characteristics, while also creating opportunities for developing smart agricultural technology suited to agricultural conditions in Indonesia.

Dr. Andri also visited the WUR Vision + Robotics Laboratory and discussed with researchers about the technologies and research activities being developed. In particular, discussions with Arjan Vroegop focused on plant phenotyping simulation and its relevance to future collaborative research plans. The laboratory visit provided insights into the use of imaging and robotics systems to support plant phenotype measurement and agricultural automation activities.

![IMAGE_1]

With Assoc. Prof. Gert Kootstra following a discussion on robotics for plant phenotyping

In addition to the staff mobility agenda, Dr. Andri also accompanied the International Joint Supervision activities for Mohammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, a student in the Master's Program in Agricultural Engineering at UGM. Through a co-supervision program with Dr. Joseph Peller, Athala had the opportunity to participate in direct supervision and conduct laboratory practicum at the WUR Vision + Robotics Laboratory. This activity strengthened the student's academic experience through direct involvement in an international research environment.

During a meeting with the WUR cooperation department, Dr. Andri presented a proposal for joint research on robotics and plant phenotyping for tropical agriculture. The discussions also focused on identifying funding opportunities and developing strategic steps so that these ideas can be developed into joint research proposals and collaborative scientific publications.

Dr. Andri stated that the opportunity to learn and discuss directly with WUR researchers was an extremely valuable experience. In addition to observing various technological advances in spectral imaging, plant phenotyping, and agricultural robotics, he also gained important learning from the work ethic and culture of learning and collaboration that flourishes within WUR's research environment. The open discussion culture, cross-disciplinary collaborative work, and discipline in conducting research became important impressions during the visit.

![IMAGE_2]

Group photo with WUR project development staff, Dr. Joseph Peller, Priska Prasetya, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, and Athala Fawwaz

The visit also provided understanding of how research institutions build and manage cooperation with industry partners. The linkage between academic activities, research, technology development, and industry needs demonstrates the importance of building an innovation ecosystem so that research results can provide broader benefits. As one of the world's leading universities in agriculture, WUR is a strategic partner in the development of future agricultural research. This visit is expected to lay the foundation for more concrete cooperation between UGM and WUR, including in research, publications, joint proposal development, and faculty and student capacity building.

This activity reaffirms UGM's commitment to expanding its global network and improving research quality in the field of smart agriculture. The UGM–WUR collaboration is expected to produce innovations relevant to tropical agriculture and support the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly SDG 2 on Zero Hunger, SDG 9 on Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure, and SDG 17 on Partnerships to Achieve the Goals.

original.body:
**Wageningen, Belanda —** Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, dosen Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), sekaligus peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), melaksanakan program _staff mobility_ di Wageningen University & Research (WUR), Belanda, pada 1–12 September 2026. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari International Joint Research Academy (IJRA) yang bertujuan memperkuat jejaring dan kolaborasi riset internasional UGM.

Agenda utama kunjungan meliputi penjajakan kerja sama antara UGM dan WUR, diskusi mengenai penelitian kolaboratif, perencanaan publikasi bersama, serta penyusunan proposal penelitian bersama. Dalam kegiatan tersebut, Dr. Andri berdiskusi dengan sejumlah mitra peneliti di WUR, yaitu Dr. Joseph Peller dalam bidang _spectral imaging for plant phenotyping_, Prof. Dr. Gerrit Polder dalam bidang teknologi pencitraan spektral, serta Assoc. Prof. Gert Kootstra dalam bidang robotika pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1026-1-image-4-1030x773.webp)

Diskusi progres Joint Supervision bersama Prof. Gerrit Polder dan dr. Joseph Peller

Salah satu fokus pembahasan adalah pengembangan riset yang mengintegrasikan teknologi robotika dan _plant phenotyping_ untuk pertanian tropis. Pendekatan ini diharapkan dapat mendukung pengamatan karakteristik tanaman secara lebih objektif, cepat, dan akurat, sekaligus membuka peluang pengembangan teknologi pertanian cerdas yang sesuai dengan kondisi pertanian di Indonesia.

Dr. Andri juga mengunjungi Laboratorium Vision + Robotics WUR dan berdiskusi dengan para peneliti mengenai teknologi serta kegiatan riset yang sedang dikembangkan. Bersama Arjan Vroegop, diskusi secara khusus membahas simulasi _plant phenotyping_ dan keterkaitannya dengan rencana penelitian kolaboratif pada masa mendatang. Kunjungan laboratorium tersebut memberikan wawasan mengenai pemanfaatan sistem pencitraan dan robotika untuk mendukung pengukuran fenotipe tanaman serta otomasi kegiatan pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1026-2-image-6-1030x773.webp)

Bersama dengan Assoc. Prof. Gert Kootstra setelah berdiskusi mengenai robotics untuk plant phenotyping

Selain menjalankan agenda _staff mobility_, Dr. Andri turut mendampingi kegiatan International Joint Supervision bagi Mohammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, mahasiswa Program Studi Magister Teknik Pertanian UGM. Melalui program pembimbingan bersama dengan Dr. Joseph Peller, Athala memperoleh kesempatan untuk mengikuti supervisi secara langsung dan melaksanakan praktik laboratorium di Laboratorium Vision + Robotics WUR. Kegiatan ini memperkuat pengalaman akademik mahasiswa melalui keterlibatan langsung dalam lingkungan riset internasional.

Dalam pertemuan dengan bagian kerja sama WUR, Dr. Andri menyampaikan usulan rencana penelitian bersama mengenai robotika dan _plant phenotyping_ untuk pertanian tropis. Pembahasan juga diarahkan pada identifikasi peluang pendanaan dan penyusunan langkah strategis agar gagasan tersebut dapat dikembangkan menjadi proposal riset bersama dan publikasi ilmiah kolaboratif.

Dr. Andri menyampaikan bahwa kesempatan untuk belajar dan berdiskusi langsung dengan para peneliti WUR merupakan pengalaman yang sangat berharga. Selain melihat berbagai kemajuan teknologi dalam bidang pencitraan spektral, _plant phenotyping_, dan robotika pertanian, ia juga memperoleh pembelajaran penting dari etos kerja serta budaya belajar dan bekerja sama yang tumbuh dalam lingkungan penelitian WUR. Budaya diskusi yang terbuka, kerja kolaboratif lintas bidang, dan kedisiplinan dalam menjalankan penelitian menjadi impresi penting selama kunjungan tersebut.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1026-3-image-5-1030x773.webp)

Foto bersama project development WUR, dr. Joseph Peller, Priska Prasetya, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, Athala Fawwaz

Kunjungan ini juga memberikan pemahaman mengenai cara institusi riset membangun dan mengelola kerja sama dengan mitra industri. Keterhubungan antara kegiatan akademik, penelitian, pengembangan teknologi, dan kebutuhan industri menunjukkan pentingnya membangun ekosistem inovasi agar hasil riset dapat memberikan manfaat yang lebih luas. Sebagai salah satu universitas terkemuka dunia di bidang pertanian, WUR menjadi mitra strategis dalam pengembangan riset pertanian masa depan. Kunjungan ini diharapkan menjadi fondasi bagi kerja sama yang lebih konkret antara UGM dan WUR, baik dalam penelitian, publikasi, penyusunan proposal bersama, maupun pengembangan kapasitas dosen dan mahasiswa.

Kegiatan ini menegaskan komitmen UGM untuk memperluas jejaring global dan meningkatkan kualitas riset di bidang pertanian cerdas. Kolaborasi UGM–WUR diharapkan dapat menghasilkan inovasi yang relevan bagi pertanian tropis dan mendukung pencapaian Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan, khususnya SDG 2 tentang Tanpa Kelaparan, SDG 9 tentang Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur, serta SDG 17 tentang Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan.
